name: MEEQ Inc.
summary: MEEQ Inc., formed in 2019 with its base in Tokyo, Japan, works mainly in mobile IoT support. Its flagship MEEQ is an IoT mobile data communication service that lets clients obtain and centrally manage many communication lines from one console. It also provides database and data processing functions that allow IoT systems to be built with little or no coding, and business tools for IoT operations.
